subject: Security & Compliance: Architecture review / SOC 2 evidence - scheduling
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Security & compliance architecture review (SOC 2 evidence)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing for our SOC 2 assessment and would like a technical deep-dive / architecture review focused on evidence collection: encryption at rest/in transit, key management, audit logs and retention, SSO/OAuth and SAML integration, and how Redwood surfaces evidence for auditors.

Would love to schedule a ~60 minute call with your engineering/security lead. Our preferred windows next week are:
- Mon, Jun 14: 9:00-11:00 PT
- Tue, Jun 15: 10:00-12:00 PT

Attendees from our side will be myself and Bobby Chen (infra/security). Could you confirm who will join from Redwood and share any prep materials or a short agenda? I'll also attach our initial question set.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Security, Acme Corp

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the note and for sending the question set. We can absolutely run a 60-minute architecture review that maps our controls to your SOC 2 artifacts and shows where auditors can find evidence. Suggested attendees from our side: myself (security/compliance), Dev Patel (serving runtime/architecture), and Aditya Rao (customer success / engagement owner).

Tentative times that work for us:
- Mon, Jun 14: 10:00-11:00 PT
- Tue, Jun 15: 11:00-12:00 PT

Could you confirm which slot you'd prefer? Also, to help us prepare, can you flag any high-priority items in the attached questionnaire and call out any required artifacts (e.g., KMS key policy, audit log exports) you'll need during/after the session. I'm attaching a short SOC 2 evidence request template so we can align beforehand.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Intro & scope (5m)
2) Architecture walk-through: data flows, encryption, KMS (20m)
3) Audit logging & retention, evidence access (15m)
4) SSO / IdP integration & user provisioning (10m)
5) Q&A / next steps / evidence handoff (10m)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Tue, Jun 15 at 10:00 PT works best for us. Bobby will join as the primary technical contact. High priority for us is:
- KMS key custody and rotation (are customer keys supported / bring-your-own-key?)
- Audit log export format and retention policy (we need 2 years of immutable logs)
- Evidence retrieval for config & access reviews (who can generate artifacts)
- SSO provisioning & SCIM support

We'll upload a highlighted version of the questionnaire with the highest-priority questions before the call. Please send a calendar invite when you can.
